verdict.rationale: There are only indirect signals of retention control. A `--no-session` flag lets a run skip persisting a session, and task and Ledger data live in Git-native records in the user's own checkout. Artifacts also support "intentional payload modes," which hints at choices about what gets retained. Missing for 10: documented retention policies or settings, explicit deletion or purge commands for sessions, records and artifacts, any statement about data sent to model providers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
